We dropped off clothes at the laundry to be washed and dried. Initially, a price was quoted without applying the new customer discount. Only after inquiring the discount was granted. The laundry was supposed to be delivered to the hotel between 10:30 and 11:15 a.m. The actual time was 12:00 p.m.

Unfortunately, the laundry also came back with stains that weren't removed. However, it smelled good and there were no complaints about that. Furthermore a note was attached to each item of clothing, which also left holes in some of the garments.

Conclusion: Check your bill carefully and compare them with the rates shown online, otherwise you may end up paying extortionate prices. In addition,  some stains did not come out and some of the clothes were damaged. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend theie services.
